name: Maximum Entertainment AB
summary: Maximum Entertainment AB, an entertainment company, engages in the development, publishing, transmedia, sale, and operation of video games in North America, Europe, Asia, and internationally. It also sells game accessories and other game-related merchandise. The company was formerly known as Zordix AB (publ) and changed its name to Maximum Entertainment AB in August 2023. Maximum Entertainment AB was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
